Container.Name: ReelPing
Container.Overview:
ReelPing is a lightweight, self-hosted Plex Media Server status monitor and Discord notifier. It continuously checks whether your Plex server is reachable and, when a confirmed outage occurs, sends one clear Discord notification (and a recovery notice with the outage duration when Plex returns). An authenticated web interface lets you announce scheduled maintenance, "going offline now", delays, and custom messages with one click.
ReelPing works with Plex hosted anywhere reachable over the network: an Unraid Docker container, a VM, another NAS, or another server. It needs NO privileged mode, NO Docker socket, NO host networking, and NO access to Plex's configuration or media — only a network URL it can reach.
Enter your Plex token and Discord webhook in the authenticated web UI (never in this template). Uses Discord incoming webhooks — no Discord bot required.
ReelPing is an independent community project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Plex, Inc., Discord Inc., or Lime Technology, Inc.
Container.Requires: ReelPing reaches Plex over the network. Point it at your Plex server's LAN address and published port (for Plex in an Unraid Docker container, use http://UNRAID_LAN_IP:32400). No Plex token is required for basic monitoring.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the ReelPing web interface (container and host use 8787).

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent storage for ReelPing's database and settings.

Config.Name: Time Zone
Config.Description: Your local time zone (e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID (Unraid default 99). Informational; the container runs as 99:100.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID (Unraid default 100). Informational; the container runs as 99:100.
